nodes.label: Cursed_Vishleshan
nodes.description: Windows desktop app for transcribing, translating, and summarizing video/audio/live sound, voice cleanup, and music stem extraction.

nodes.label: Whisper
nodes.description: Local speech recognition engine (GPU-accelerated on NVIDIA). Supports models from tiny to large-v3.

nodes.label: Claude Code
nodes.description: Online AI backend for high-quality summaries and translations.

nodes.label: Ollama
nodes.description: Offline AI backend for summaries and translations.

nodes.label: LM Studio
nodes.description: Local AI server for summaries and translations.

nodes.label: pywebview
nodes.description: Native window host for the HTML/CSS/JS interface.

nodes.label: Demucs
nodes.description: Engine for voice isolation and background music extraction (stems).

nodes.label: DeepFilterNet
nodes.description: Offline noise removal engine.

nodes.label: ElevenLabs
nodes.description: Online Voice Isolator API.

nodes.label: sherpa-onnx
nodes.description: Offline speaker detection and labeling.

nodes.label: yt-dlp
nodes.description: Tool for downloading YouTube videos and playlists.

nodes.label: edge-tts
nodes.description: Microsoft neural voices for online read-aloud.

nodes.label: app.py
nodes.description: Main host and JS bridge (Api), manages background threads.

nodes.label: live.py
nodes.description: GUI-free live capture engine for mic, system audio, and calls.

nodes.label: video_summarizer.py
nodes.description: Core processing backend for transcription, translation, and cleanup.

nodes.label: Web UI
nodes.description: HTML/CSS/JS frontend (index.html, caption.html).

nodes.label: Caption Overlay
nodes.description: Always-on-top subtitle bar for live transcription.

nodes.label: Home Screen
nodes.description: Main interface for source selection and output configuration.

nodes.label: Voice Cleanup Tab
nodes.description: Interface for standalone audio cleaning and music extraction.

nodes.label: Offline Settings Tab
nodes.description: Configuration for AI backend priorities and local server addresses.

nodes.label: History Tab
nodes.description: Searchable log of all processed media with preview and edit capabilities.
